senses.gloss:
(-विः) 
__1 A beast of prey. 
__2 The birch tree. 
__3 N. of a country (pl.); [[Mb. 5. 195. 7.]] 
__4 N. of a [Page1552-2] king (who is said to have saved Agni in the form of a dove from Indra in the form of a hawk by offering an equal quantity of his own flesh weighed in a balance); शिबेरिव समुद्भूतं शरणागतरक्षया [[Mu. 6. 18.]]

शिबि(वि)का
 
__1 A palanquin, litter. 
__2 A bier. 
__3 A raised platform.

शिबि(वि)रम्
 
__1 A camp; विद्रुते शिबिरे शून्ये [[Mb. 9. 30. 3]], 4; धृष्टद्युम्नः स्वशिबिरमयं याति सर्वे सहध्वम् [[Ve. 3. 18]]; [[Śi. 5. 68.]] 
__2 A royal camp or residence. 
__3 An intrenchment for the protection of an army. 
__4 A kind of grain.
